reports.title: Monarch Ramparts Skier Triggered
reports.comment: incident: NE slope, at 2300m. Remote triggered from above by second skier. Stepped down to base. Size 1.0 to 1.5. No injuries.

reports.title: Floe creek
reports.comment: quick: Went to floe creek area today on the 93s, hs was 115cm after crossing the kootany River, went up the due north aspect shoulder at the start of the creek. Was - 3 at the car at 9:15am at 1315m elev, a temp crust was present until about 1450m, which had broken down and became quite soft by later day 2:30pm. Temps went to +3 in the parking lot by 3pm. reports.title: Floe Lake Burn
reports.comment:
avalanche: Skied the big slide path in the Floe Lake Burn zone from the top. Snowpack skinning on ridge alternated between supportive settled pow, facetting snow and a thin slab on a hard (windpressed?) surface. No signs of instability outside of one isolated area where settlements and cracks were heard and seen. Winds calm and maybe 2-3cm of new snow. -8 at the top, overcast.

reports.title: Quartz - SSV
reports.comment: quick: Amazing conditions on Quartz hill - we bagged both summits and descended on E aspect of second summit. Snow quality was amazing - about 45cm of unconsolidated snow sitting on the remains of old wind slab that was decomposing. Winds were very light this am but picked up in pm and clouds rolled in.
